subject: Re: Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large
parts:
You need to make the plot window larger, by dragging one corner. The settings for the margins are such that there’s no room to include the actual plots.

karl

> Would you please advise me that what is wrong that I am facing with this ERRORS? And how can I solve it? In advance, I really do appreciate you.
>
> > CHN <- read.cross("csv", "c:/My Data", "CHN.csv")
> --Read the following data:
> 33 individuals
> 37 markers
> 1 phenotypes
> --Cross type: f2
> > CHN <- calc.genoprob(CHN, step=2.5, err=0.001)
> > out2 <- scantwo(CHN, verbose=FALSE)
> > plot(out2, chr=c(4,6,8))
> Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large
